scope.selected_named_test: isolateSlowThreshold isolates slow files across shards

semantics.underlying_bug: When only one file is slow and two shards exist, delivered implementation puts a normal file on the isolated slow shard. Both successful changes expose this same independent Verifier isolation defect.

historical_transfer.condition: Only file1 remains slow; files2,3,4 are normal. The full b/c record distributions are below150 under the history smoothing rule.
historical_transfer.counting_note: One duration-distribution/cardinality condition is realized by two coupled record substitutions. It is not two independently useful semantic repairs; singleton controls show each alone leaves two slow files and passes P.

derived_threshold.condition: Original durations400,300,200,100 with threshold350 leave only file1 slow.
derived_threshold.provenance: New numeric value chosen to instantiate the historical one-slow/two-shards condition; not exact historical record reuse.

singleton_controls.b_only: Two slow files remain (1,3); P and R pass.
singleton_controls.c_only: Two slow files remain (1,2); P and R pass.
singleton_controls.interpretation: Both substitutions are necessary within this frozen historical-record plan. Controls do not prove global minimality or exclude other one-parameter repairs, as threshold350 itself succeeds.

semantics.oracle: Original assertion shard1==[1] and shard2==[2,3,4] correctly expresses isolation whenever only file1 is isolated; no output expectation or target operation was regenerated. The comment describing three slow files is stale after edit but does not affect assertion semantics.

production_integrity.note: Snapshots include all23 P/R patch-union paths, including overwritten fixture/test files. They establish source stability within runs; compiled build artifacts differ by intended P/R implementation.
